description: Working memory for reusable codebase patterns and gotchas discovered during pipeline runs. Append-only comments; promote proven patterns per the 3-houses rule (technical -> docs/adr/, process -> docs/, repo guidance -> AGENTS.md via gated ticket). Working memory != gospel. Never moves past Backlog.

comments.body:
<!-- sdlc:stage=backlog kind=summary -->
From TKT-25 (codex review patterns to bake into future service slices): self-contained local gate (`make deps` before `make check`), publish Compose ports on 127.0.0.1 only, pin tool versions, never track build artifacts/node_modules. Source: PR #1 review fixes (e85bd44).

<!-- sdlc:stage=backlog kind=summary -->
From TKT-42 (CI patterns): 1) pnpm/action-setup@v6 broken in default AND standalone modes (issue #276) — use corepack on runners (version from packageManager, same as the Dockerfiles). Before bumping any pinned GH Action major, scan its open issues. 2) GHA type=gha layer cache does not persist RUN --mount=type=cache — in-Docker compiles are always cold in CI; package host-built artifacts instead (docs/testing.md §Smoke build paths).

<!-- sdlc:stage=backlog kind=summary -->
**From TKT-26 (US-002), 2026-07-12:**
- **Event envelope precedent (ADR-009 §5):** `{id, type, occurred_at, schema, data}`; id is deterministic per business fact (uuid5 of entity id + transition timestamp) and doubles as `Nats-Msg-Id`; subjects `platform.<service>.<entity>.<fact>`. All future emitters copy this.
- **Publish gating rule:** a state transition that emits a public event must validate the entity is coherent for consumers at transition time (US-002: no ticket type -> 409) — never emit for a state the read path will hide.
- **New web app wiring checklist (4 points):** pnpm-workspace + .dockerignore whitelist + compose.smoke override + smoke.sh preflight.
- **Astro SSR ships dist-only** via `vite ssr.noExternal` (runtime images need no node_modules).
- **SSR page caching rule made code:** cache key = full URL; single cache owner per tier; outgoing HTML TTL = remaining data freshness; single-flight on miss. `web/storefront/src/lib/cache.ts` is the reference implementation for TKT-31.

TKT-27 learning (2026-07-12): external AI review sessions may attach stale project context and confidently cite nonexistent files. Require a fresh external-tool project plus repository fingerprint checks (HEAD and known file/toolchain facts) before accepting review findings. Candidate promotion target: project-local sdlc-ticket cross-model review instructions.

<!-- sdlc:stage=backlog kind=summary -->
### 🧠 Promoted from TKT-103 — composite-FK tenancy is the repo idiom for `performances` cross-refs

**Pattern:** cross-table tenancy on a `performances` foreign reference is enforced at the DATABASE with a **composite FK** `(child_ref, organizer_id[, venue_id]) → parent(id, organizer_id[, venue_id])`, backed by a composite UNIQUE on the parent — NOT a store-query check alone.

**Why:** a plain single-column FK only proves the parent row exists; the composite FK makes a cross-organizer/cross-venue reference *unrepresentable* even for a direct SQL / repair path (ADR-002 physical boundary), which a store-query check does not.

**Instances:** festivals capacity group (`0006_festivals.sql`: `performances_capacity_group_fk → festivals(id, organizer_id)`); seat maps (`0010_publish_seat_maps.sql`: `performances_seat_map_fk → seat_maps(id, organizer_id, venue_id)`).

**MATCH SIMPLE caveat (safe here):** the child ref column is nullable; when NULL the composite FK is skipped (correct for a GA/ungrouped slot). When non-NULL, organizer_id/venue_id are NOT NULL so all columns are present and the FK is fully enforced. No partial-set hole.

**Apply when:** any future `performances → X` reference (or similar owned cross-ref). Reach for the composite FK first; a store-query tenancy check is defense-in-depth on top, not the primary guard. TKT-103's ai-review (gpt-5.6-luna) caught a plan that used only the store-query check — it was the plan's one net-new, single-model-reviewed element.
